extends SceneTree

## NUT-208A legacy_evidence_only: observations of the current production rules.
## This is not a test suite or an oracle for the replacement recovery rules.
## No production formula is copied here; controlled inputs call live methods.
## Run: godot --headless --path life-strategy --script
## res://tests/legacy_recovery_audit_probe.gd -- --output=res://.godot/nut208a/legacy_baseline.json
## Controllers never enter the scene tree. Health features are explicitly off,
## health_history_path is empty, and the probe rejects user:// output paths.

const Data := preload("res://scripts/GameData.gd")
const Cards := preload("res://scripts/CardDataStore.gd")
const Resolver := preload("res://scripts/systems/MealResolver.gd")
const Carryover := preload("res://scripts/systems/DayCarryoverService.gd")
const Deck := preload("res://scripts/systems/MealDeckService.gd")
const Ledger := preload("res://scripts/systems/NutritionLedger.gd")
const DEFAULT_OUTPUT := "res://.godot/nut208a/legacy_baseline.json"
const SEED := 20260711
const SOURCE_PATHS := [
	"res://scripts/GameData.gd", "res://scripts/CardDataStore.gd",
	"res://scripts/ui_v2/GameRootV2.gd",
	"res://scripts/systems/MealResolver.gd",
	"res://scripts/systems/DayCarryoverService.gd",
	"res://scripts/systems/NutritionLedger.gd",
	"res://scripts/systems/WeeklyEventService.gd",
	"res://scripts/systems/MealDeckService.gd",
	"res://scripts/systems/FoodPreferenceService.gd",
	"res://data/cards/foods.xml", "res://data/cards/meal_sources.xml",
	"res://data/cards/actions.xml", "res://data/cards/sleep_options.xml",
	"res://data/characters/default_food_preferences.xml",
]


class AuditController:
	extends "res://scripts/ui_v2/GameRootV2.gd"

	var audit_before_finish: Dictionary = {}

	func _finish_day() -> void:
		# Observe the exact sleep/settlement boundary, then invoke the real method.
		audit_before_finish = state.duplicate(true)
		super._finish_day()


var _errors: Array[String] = []


func _initialize() -> void:
	call_deferred("_run")


func _run() -> void:
	var output := _output_path()
	if output.is_empty():
		quit(1)
		return
	Data.ensure_loaded()
	var hashes := {}
	for path in SOURCE_PATHS:
		hashes[path] = FileAccess.get_sha256(path)
	var report := {
		"schema": "nut208a.legacy_recovery_evidence.v1",
		"legacy_evidence_only": true,
		"not_replacement_rule_expectations": true,
		"purpose": "Frozen observations for migration review; no clinical meaning or new-rule acceptance criteria.",
		"engine": Engine.get_version_info()["string"],
		"seed": SEED,
		"source_sha256": hashes,
		"isolation": {"controller_added_to_tree": false, "health_flags": "all_off", "health_history_path": ""},
		"starting_state": Data.get_starting_stats(),
		"burden_catalog": _catalog(),
		"representative_meals": _representative_meals(),
		"action_observations": _action_observations(),
		"sleep_observations": _sleep_observations(),
		"combo_observations": _combo_observations(),
		"mixed_day": _mixed_day(),
		"day_end_boundaries": _day_end_boundaries(),
		"carryover_burden_boundaries": _carryover_boundaries(),
		"stability_boundaries": _stability_boundaries(),
		"ending_boundaries": _ending_boundaries(),
		"clamp_and_hud_conversion": _clamp_observations(),
		"seven_day_flow": _seven_day_flow(),
		"early_collapse_flow": _early_collapse_flow(),
	}
	report["probe_errors"] = _errors.duplicate()
	var absolute := ProjectSettings.globalize_path(output)
	var directory_error := DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(absolute.get_base_dir())
	if directory_error != OK:
		push_error("Cannot create evidence directory: %s" % absolute.get_base_dir())
		quit(1)
		return
	var file := FileAccess.open(absolute, FileAccess.WRITE)
	if file == null:
		push_error("Cannot write evidence: %s" % absolute)
		quit(1)
		return
	file.store_string(JSON.stringify(report, "\t", true) + "\n")
	file.close()
	print("NUT208A_LEGACY_EVIDENCE=" + JSON.stringify({
		"legacy_evidence_only": true, "output": absolute, "errors": _errors,
		"food_count": Cards.food_ids.size(),
		"seven_day_ending": report["seven_day_flow"]["ending_id"],
		"days_recorded": report["seven_day_flow"]["days"].size(),
	}))
	quit(0 if _errors.is_empty() else 1)


func _output_path() -> String:
	var output := DEFAULT_OUTPUT
	var args := OS.get_cmdline_user_args()
	for index in range(args.size()):
		if args[index].begins_with("--output="):
			output = args[index].trim_prefix("--output=")
		elif args[index] == "--output" and index + 1 < args.size():
			output = args[index + 1]
	if output.is_empty() or output.begins_with("user://"):
		push_error("Evidence output must be nonempty and outside user://")
		return ""
	return "res://" + output if output.is_relative_path() else output


func _new_controller() -> AuditController:
	var game := AuditController.new()
	game.health_guidance_flags = {"data": false, "engine": false, "ui": false, "weekly": false}
	game.health_history_path = ""
	game._deck_service = Deck.new(SEED)
	game.start_new_run()
	return game


func _controlled_state() -> Dictionary:
	var state := Data.get_starting_stats()
	state.merge({
		"balance": 120, "energy": 60, "mood": 60, "stress": 40,
		"satiety": 50, "diet_burden": 50, "study_progress": 70,
	}, true)
	return state


func _catalog() -> Dictionary:
	var result := {}
	for group in [
		["foods", Cards.food_ids, Callable(Data, "get_food")],
		["meal_sources", Cards.meal_source_ids, Callable(Data, "get_meal_source")],
		["actions", Cards.action_ids, Callable(Data, "get_action")],
		["sleep_options", Cards.sleep_option_ids, Callable(Data, "get_sleep_option")],
	]:
		var rows: Array[Dictionary] = []
		for id in group[1]:
			var item: Dictionary = group[2].call(id)
			rows.append({"id": id, "name": item["name"], "burden": int(item.get("burden", 0))})
		result[group[0]] = rows
	return result


func _meal(phase: String, source_id: String, ids: Array) -> Dictionary:
	var foods: Array[Dictionary] = []
	for id in ids:
		foods.append(Data.get_food(id))
	return Resolver.build_record(phase, Data.get_meal_source(source_id), foods)


func _representative_meals() -> Array[Dictionary]:
	return [
		_meal("lunch", "cafeteria", ["rice_plain", "tofu", "greens"]),
		_meal("lunch", "takeout", ["fried_chicken", "bubble_tea"]),
		_meal("breakfast", "convenience_store", ["milk", "apple"]),
		_meal("dinner", "dorm_storage", ["instant_noodles"]),
		Resolver.build_skipped_record("lunch"),
	]


func _change(before: Dictionary, after: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
	var delta := {}
	for key in before:
		if after.has(key) and (before[key] is int or before[key] is float):
			delta[key] = int(after[key]) - int(before[key])
	return {"before": before.duplicate(true), "after": after.duplicate(true), "observed_delta": delta}


func _action_observations() -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var rows: Array[Dictionary] = []
	for day in [1, 2, 6]:
		for action_id in ["drink_water", "walk", "allow_imperfection", "nap"]:
			var game := _new_controller()
			game.day = day
			game.state = _controlled_state()
			game.phase = "breakfast_action"
			var before := game.state.duplicate(true)
			game._apply_action(action_id)
			var row := _change(before, game.state)
			row.merge({"day": day, "action_id": action_id, "records": game.today_action_records.duplicate(true)})
			rows.append(row)
			game.free()
	return rows


func _sleep_observations() -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var rows: Array[Dictionary] = []
	for option_id in Data.get_sleep_option_ids_for_scene("sleep"):
		var game := _new_controller()
		game.state = _controlled_state()
		game._day_start_state = game.state.duplicate(true)
		# Identical settled-meal fixtures isolate each live sleep choice.
		for phase in ["breakfast", "lunch", "dinner"]:
			game.today_meal_records.append(_meal(phase, "cafeteria", ["rice_plain", "egg", "tomato"]))
		game.phase = "sleep"
		var before_sleep := game.state.duplicate(true)
		game._choose_sleep(option_id)
		rows.append({
			"controlled_fixture": true,
			"sleep_option": Data.get_sleep_option(option_id),
			"before_sleep": before_sleep,
			"after_sleep_before_finish": game.audit_before_finish.duplicate(true),
			"final_state": game.state.duplicate(true),
			"pending_learning_state": game.pending_learning_state.duplicate(true),
			"meal_records": game.today_meal_records.duplicate(true),
		})
		game.free()
	return rows


func _combo_observations() -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var game := _new_controller()
	game.state = _controlled_state()
	var rows: Array[Dictionary] = []
	for record in [
		_meal("breakfast", "cafeteria", ["rice_plain", "egg", "tomato"]),
		_meal("lunch", "takeout", ["bubble_tea"]),
		_meal("dinner", "dorm_storage", ["instant_noodles"]),
	]:
		var before := game.state.duplicate(true)
		game._apply_meal_record(record)
		var row := _change(before, game.state)
		row.merge({"record": record, "combos_after": game.combos_today.duplicate()})
		rows.append(row)
	game.free()
	return rows


func _mixed_day() -> Dictionary:
	var game := _new_controller()
	game.state = _controlled_state()
	game._day_start_state = game.state.duplicate(true)
	var rows: Array[Dictionary] = []
	var plan := [
		["breakfast", "dorm_storage", ["instant_noodles"], "drink_water"],
		["lunch", "takeout", ["fried_chicken", "bubble_tea"], "walk"],
		["dinner", "cafeteria", ["rice_plain", "tofu", "greens"], "drink_water"],
	]
	for choice in plan:
		var before := game.state.duplicate(true)
		var record := _meal(choice[0], choice[1], choice[2])
		game._apply_meal_record(record)
		var after_meal := game.state.duplicate(true)
		game.phase = "%s_action" % choice[0]
		game._apply_action(choice[3])
		rows.append({
			"meal": record, "meal_change": _change(before, after_meal),
			"action_id": choice[3], "action_change": _change(after_meal, game.state),
		})
	var before_sleep := game.state.duplicate(true)
	game._choose_sleep("sleep_early")
	var result := {
		"controlled_fixture": true, "steps": rows,
		"sleep_change": _change(before_sleep, game.audit_before_finish),
		"day_end_change": _change(game.audit_before_finish, game.state),
		"nutrition_after_actions_and_sleep": Ledger.summarize(game.today_meal_records),
		"meal_records_after_actions_and_sleep": game.today_meal_records.duplicate(true),
		"combos": game.combos_today.duplicate(),
		"next_day_state": game.pending_learning_state.duplicate(true),
	}
	game.free()
	return result


func _day_end_boundaries() -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var rows: Array[Dictionary] = []
	for score in [41, 42, 65, 66]:
		for satiety in [92, 93]:
			var game := _new_controller()
			game.state = _controlled_state()
			game.state["satiety"] = satiety
			for phase in ["breakfast", "lunch", "dinner"]:
				var record := _meal(phase, "cafeteria", ["rice_plain"])
				# Synthetic legacy-quality input isolates the production day-end branch.
				# This number is never an expected value for replacement rules.
				record["quality"] = score
				game.today_meal_records.append(record)
			var before := game.state.duplicate(true)
			game._finish_day()
			var row := _change(before, game.state)
			row.merge({"synthetic_quality_input": score, "satiety_input": satiety})
			rows.append(row)
			game.free()
	return rows


func _carryover_boundaries() -> Dictionary:
	var records: Array[Dictionary] = []
	for phase in ["breakfast", "lunch", "dinner"]:
		records.append(_meal(phase, "cafeteria", ["rice_plain", "egg", "tomato"]))
	var summary := Ledger.summarize(records)
	var base := _controlled_state()
	var rows: Array[Dictionary] = []
	for burden in [55, 56, 67, 68, 81, 82]:
		var state := base.duplicate(true)
		state["diet_burden"] = burden
		rows.append({"burden": burden, "result": Carryover.evaluate_day(summary, [], "sleep_early", state)})
	return {"summary": summary, "base_state": base, "actions": [], "sleep_id": "sleep_early", "rows": rows}


func _stability_boundaries() -> Dictionary:
	var base := _controlled_state()
	var rows: Array[Dictionary] = []
	for dimension in [
		["diet_burden", [0, 24, 50, 60, 61, 100]],
		["energy", [15, 16]], ["mood", [15, 16]],
		["satiety", [11, 12]], ["stress", [88, 89]],
		["balance", [35, 36, 59, 60]],
	]:
		for value in dimension[1]:
			var state := base.duplicate(true)
			state[dimension[0]] = value
			rows.append({
				"key": dimension[0], "value": value,
				"stability": Resolver.calculate_stability(state, 70, 1, 7),
			})
	return {"base_state": base, "avg_quality": 70, "day": 1, "total_days": 7, "rows": rows}


func _ending_boundaries() -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var rows: Array[Dictionary] = []
	for stability in [15, 16, 24, 25, 59, 60]:
		for study in [49, 50, 69, 70]:
			for burden in [60, 61]:
				var state := _controlled_state()
				state.merge({"stability": stability, "study_progress": study, "diet_burden": burden}, true)
				rows.append({
					"stability": stability, "study_progress": study, "burden": burden,
					"ending_id": Resolver.select_ending(state),
				})
	return rows


func _clamp_observations() -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var rows: Array[Dictionary] = []
	var game := _new_controller()
	for burden in [-1, 0, 1, 99, 100, 101]:
		game.state["diet_burden"] = burden
		game._clamp_stats()
		rows.append({
			"input_burden": burden, "clamped_burden": game.state["diet_burden"],
			"character_health_display": Data.character_health_from_burden(burden),
			"delta_display_for_same_input": Data.character_health_delta_from_burden(burden),
		})
	game.free()
	return rows


func _seven_day_flow() -> Dictionary:
	var game := _new_controller()
	var days: Array[Dictionary] = []
	while game.phase != "ending" and game.day <= Data.TOTAL_DAYS:
		var opening := game.state.duplicate(true)
		for meal in ["breakfast", "lunch", "dinner"]:
			game._choose_meal_source("cafeteria")
			var preferred := ["rice_plain", "egg", "tomato", "mixed_grain_rice"] if meal == "breakfast" else ["rice_plain", "tofu", "greens", "tomato", "mixed_grain_rice"]
			var plate: Array[String] = []
			var running_cost := int(game._effective_meal_source("cafeteria").get("fee", 0))
			for food_id in preferred:
				var cost := int(Data.get_food(food_id)["cost"])
				if game.hand.has(food_id) and running_cost + cost <= int(game.state["balance"]):
					plate.append(food_id)
					running_cost += cost
				if plate.size() >= 2:
					break
			game._confirm_food(plate)
			if game.phase != "%s_action" % meal:
				_errors.append("Seven-day meal did not advance: day %d %s" % [game.day, meal])
				break
			game._apply_action("study")
		if game.phase != "sleep":
			_errors.append("Seven-day route did not reach sleep: day %d %s" % [game.day, game.phase])
			break
		var before_sleep := game.state.duplicate(true)
		game._choose_sleep("sleep_early")
		days.append({
			"day": game.day, "opening_state": opening,
			"day_record": game.run_history.back().duplicate(true),
			"sleep_change": _change(before_sleep, game.audit_before_finish),
			"day_end_change": _change(game.audit_before_finish, game.state),
		})
		if game.phase == "summary":
			game._on_summary_advanced()
	var result := {
		"route": "Seeded live source selection and affordable two-card cafeteria meals; three study actions and sleep_early daily; default character preferences.",
		"seed": SEED, "days": days, "ending_id": game.ending_id,
		"phase": game.phase, "final_state": game.state.duplicate(true),
	}
	game.free()
	return result


func _early_collapse_flow() -> Dictionary:
	var game := _new_controller()
	var transitions: Array[Dictionary] = []
	for step in range(60):
		if game.phase == "ending":
			break
		var before := {"day": game.day, "phase": game.phase}
		match game.phase:
			"breakfast_source", "lunch_source", "dinner_source": game._skip_meal()
			"breakfast_action", "lunch_action", "dinner_action": game._skip_action()
			"sleep": game._choose_sleep("night_study")
			"summary": game._on_summary_advanced()
			_: break
		transitions.append({"from": before, "to": {"day": game.day, "phase": game.phase}})
	var result := {
		"route": "Skip every meal and action; night_study at sleep.",
		"transitions": transitions, "days": game.run_history.duplicate(true),
		"ending_id": game.ending_id, "final_state": game.state.duplicate(true),
		"low_stability_days": game.low_stability_days,
	}
	game.free()
	return result
